rv.q: Music City provides plenty of drama and the right songs to go with it.
Each of his songs are perfectly set into this story, arranged with excellent harmonies when called for, and gives each character who sings them a great moment to shine.

cn.t: Critics praise this country-western musical for its excellent songs and inventive staging, calling it an "extraordinary" entry that rises above typical jukebox musical fare with genuine storytelling craft.

vr.q: It's still in previews and a little rough around the edges, but I think they've got something here.
